symbols.name: coordinate label set
symbols.meaning: The finite set of coordinate labels, one for each coordinate of the vectors.
symbols.quote: Let $F$ be the field of scalars, and let $\mathcal I$ be the finite set of coordinate labels, one for each coordinate of the vectors.

symbols.name: coordinate label
symbols.meaning: A label in $\mathcal I$ that names one coordinate of the vectors.
symbols.quote: Each label $\iota\in\mathcal I$ names one coordinate, and $x_\iota$ is the value of a vector $x$ at that coordinate.

symbols.name: scalar family
symbols.meaning: A family of scalars $\tau_\iota$ in $F$, one for each label, which defines a diagonal scaling.
symbols.quote: Given a family of scalars $\tau=(\tau_\iota)_{\iota\in\mathcal I}$ with each $\tau_\iota\in F$, the diagonal scaling $\Delta_\tau$ is the map

symbols.name: diagonal scaling
symbols.meaning: The map multiplying each coordinate $\iota$ of a vector by its scalar $\tau_\iota$.
symbols.quote: Given a family of scalars $\tau=(\tau_\iota)_{\iota\in\mathcal I}$ with each $\tau_\iota\in F$, the diagonal scaling $\Delta_\tau$ is the map

symbols.name: selected bit count
symbols.meaning: The number of selected bits of an address, the count of bits that the layer acts on.
symbols.quote: Let $w$ be the number of selected bits of an address, the count of bits that the layer acts on.

symbols.name: second scalar family
symbols.meaning: A second family of scalars, one for each label, used to compose diagonal scalings.
symbols.quote: Second, for a second family $\sigma=(\sigma_\iota)_{\iota\in\mathcal I}$ of scalars, the scalings satisfy $\Delta_\tau\Delta_\sigma=\Delta_{\tau\sigma}$, where $(\tau\sigma)_\iota=\tau_\iota\sigma_\iota$.

symbols.name: zero label
symbols.meaning: A label in $\mathcal I$ whose scalar $\tau_{\iota_0}$ is zero.
symbols.quote: If some label $\iota_0\in\mathcal I$ has $\tau_{\iota_0}=0$, then $\Delta_\tau$ sends both the vector with a $1$ in coordinate $\iota_0$ and $0$ elsewhere, and the zero vector, to $0$, so two different vectors have the same image, and $\Delta_\tau$ is not invertible.

relations.quote: A diagonal scaling is built from the linear maps of [Linear algebra basics](linear-algebra-basics.md).
